title: Settled Coverage-Type Changes and the TRICARE Reserve Select Reserve Select Closing Reconciliation
content:
**TRICARE Premium-Based Plans - TRICARE Reserve Select ledger rule.**

A coverage-type change already settled for a month of the closing period changes what that month's monthly bill brings into the Reserve Select closing reconciliation: where a coverage-type change credit stands against that monthly bill, that credit is taken off; where a coverage-type adjustment bill for that month has a payment posted against it, the part paid is added; otherwise nothing is taken off or added.

1. *Change credit:* the credits with reason coverage-type change standing against the month's monthly bill, in total.
2. *Part paid:* the payments posted against the coverage-type adjustment bill of that month.
3. The cases are read in that order for each month of the closing period.

| Month's ledger (hypothetical) | Effect on what the monthly bill brings in |
|---|---|
| change credit of 88.24 against the June monthly bill | 88.24 taken off |
| June adjustment bill of 88.24 with 50.00 paid on it | 50.00 added |
| June adjustment bill with nothing paid | nothing |
| no change credit, no adjustment bill | nothing |
